abstract: CI/CD for Capacitor apps: toolchain matrix for Capacitor 8 and 9 (Node 22/24, macos-26 vs xcode-27 runners, JDK 21, Gradle/AGP 8.13 vs 9.2.1), pipeline shape choice between Capgo Cloud Build, GitHub Actions/GitLab, and Fastlane, iOS archive/export/upload with App Store Connect API keys, Android AAB signing from env, Capgo OTA uploads, caching, build numbers, verification steps, and fixes for common CI signing, JDK, Node engine, and Capgo auth errors. Full workflows in references/.
